input.prompt: Clean flat vector infographic for a website, wide landscape composition on a pure white background, corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, matching a light blue and yellow illustration set. Show a four-step AI invoice processing workflow as a single horizontal row of four identical rounded-square tiles with even gutters, connected left to right by short thick periwinkle-blue arrows placed in the gutters between the tiles. All four tiles have exactly the same pale blue #E7F0FB fill with no highlighted, selected, darker or lighter tile, a large blue circled step number (1, 2, 3, 4) in the top-left corner, one simple line-and-fill icon centered in the upper two-thirds, and one short bold navy label centered in the lower third, in a clean sans-serif font at a moderate size so every label fits on one line with clear padding. Icons contain no lettering. Tile 1 icon: an envelope and a scanned paper invoice with a scanning beam; label exactly 'Capture'. Tile 2 icon: an invoice and a purchase order side by side joined by a green check mark; label exactly 'Match'. Tile 3 icon: an approver avatar with a green tick and a small bell; label exactly 'Approve'. Tile 4 icon: a ledger book with a database cylinder and a coin; label exactly 'Post to ERP'. A single small yellow spark near the top-right corner. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, navy #1F2A44, soft green #3BB273, white. Generous outer margins, crisp edges, no dotted lines. The only text in the image is the four labels 'Capture', 'Match', 'Approve', 'Post to ERP' and the digits 1 2 3 4, all bold and perfectly spelled.
